settings.localePickerAppFolderDesc: Saves to Documents/Languages inside Android/data. An existing export for the same language is updated.
settings.localePickerImportDesc: Select one JSON file to validate and copy into app storage.
settings.localePickerExportDesc: Exports the copy in app storage for the selected language.
settings.localePickerConflict: A file for {{code}} already exists. Nothing was overwritten.
settings.localePickerMissing: There is no private file for the selected language.
nav.shortcuts: Shortcuts: Esc=Back / H=Home / C=Creators / F=Following / S=Settings
creators.searchPlaceholder: Search creators by name / ID / URL
creators.building: Building creator index… {{count}} entries (search works already)
creators.refreshConfirm: Refresh the creator list (~100,000 entries). Continue?
creators.loading: Fetching creator list (~100,000 entries, first time only)…
creators.profileError: Failed to load profile (posts are still available)
login.title: Log in
login.desc: Log in with your pawchive.pw ID and password to sync your account favorites. Your credentials are only used at login; only the session key is stored on this device.
login.sessionSet: A session key is already set
login.sessionError: Login was accepted, but the session could not be retrieved. Please try again later.
settings.languageDesc: Switch the display language (no restart required)
error.blocked: Possibly blocked by the site (Fake site)
error.blockedHint: pawchive detected a relay and is returning a fake page. Please wait a while and try again.
error.sessionInvalid: Session key is invalid or expired
error.sessionHint: Reset the session key in Settings → Account, or log in again with your ID and password.
error.tooManyRequestsHint: Server-side rate limit. Please wait a moment and try again.
error.forbiddenHint: Server-side restriction or relay detection. Please wait and try again.
error.notFoundHint: The post or creator may have been deleted, or the URL may be incorrect.
error.serverUnavailableHint: Check your network connection or wait and try again.
creator.originalTitle: Open the original fanbox / patreon creator page (no referrer sent)
favorites.desc: Check for new posts from followed creators
favorites.emptyFollows: No follows yet. Press ☆ on a creator page to follow.
favorites.accountDesc: Fetch your pawchive account post favorites
favorites.loginDesc: Log in to fetch your account favorites
favorites.sessionInvalid: Session key is invalid. Log in to pawchive.pw and paste the session cookie value into the field.
post.favAdd: Add to / remove from account post favorites
post.originalTitle: Open the original fanbox / patreon post page (no referrer sent)
post.revisionHint: The current post (latest) is shown initially. Use the dropdown to switch to older versions.
settings.title: Settings
settings.diagFlagDesc: Enabled (VITE_DEBUG_DIAG=1 / cargo feature debug-diag). Logs are appended to app_data/logs/debug-app.log. Backup JSON dumps are written from this section and on export.
settings.logFolderDesc: Open the log folder in the file manager (PC)
settings.backupDumpDesc: Write the full backup JSON to the diagnostic log (for recovering sessionKey on devices; also dumped automatically on export)
settings.dumped: Dumped to the diagnostic log (check via view or the log file)
settings.loginHint: Logging in sets the session key automatically.
settings.sessionLabel: pawchive session key (used for favorites sync)
settings.sessionHelp: Log in to pawchive.pw → Cookie → enter the session value.
settings.layoutDesc: Switch between desktop (left icon rail) and mobile (bottom navigation) layout
settings.noImageDesc: When on, thumbnails and previews are not loaded, saving a lot of data
settings.proxy: Load FANBOX / Patreon images via the pkv:// proxy
settings.proxyDesc: When on, requests carry the post URL as Referer and a browser User-Agent. The Pawchive app, API and image server are always accessed directly.
settings.fileListDesc: When on, images in posts aren't auto-loaded. List file names and load only what you need (same in low-data mode)
settings.coverDesc: When on, hides the cover image (cover.jpeg) from the post detail's file list. List thumbnails and counts are not affected (can also be toggled per post).
settings.timeoutDesc: Use a longer timeout if responses are slow or fail (default 30 s). The same value is used for login.
settings.exportDesc: Save follows, read state and settings to a JSON file (for device transfer or before a reset)
settings.importDesc: Import an exported JSON to restore follows, read state and settings (overwrites current data)
settings.importConfirm: Importing a backup overwrites your current follows, read state and settings. Continue?
settings.testInvalid: ❌ Session key is invalid or expired
settings.logDesc: Records network and unhandled errors (up to 400, {{count}} kept). Useful for diagnosing connection or login failures.
settings.aboutNote: PawKemoViewer is an unofficial client for pawchive.pw.
settings.localeInvalid: Language files that could not be read: {{files}}
settings.localeAddDesc: Enter a language code (e.g. es) and the language file (JSON). The locale.name value is shown as the name.
settings.localeDeleteConfirm: Delete the external file for language {{code}}. Continue?
settings.localeBadCode: Start the code with 2–3 letters, then optional alphanumeric parts separated by - (e.g. es, zh-Hant)
settings.localeBadJson: Not valid JSON, or locale.name is missing
settings.intro: Settings are grouped by purpose. Most display and post options take effect immediately; save the session key with the Save button.
settings.excludeAiDesc: When on, hides posts classified as AI from the global post list and search results.
settings.loginStatusDesc: Checks the session for your Pawchive account.
settings.developerSessionDesc: For development and diagnostics when normal login is unavailable. Enter the pawchive.pw session cookie value to test and save it.
settings.developerToolsDesc: When on, shows development and diagnostic controls. Normally leave this off.
settings.fullDiagnosticsDesc: Detailed logs, log-folder access, and backup dump (debug builds only)
settings.fullApiLogcatDesc: Android debug builds log request/response headers, HTTP status, and text response bodies for Pawchive API and pkv:// external proxy traffic. Cookie/Authorization and similar credential values are redacted; binary bodies are size-only. Response bodies may contain personal data, so review logs before sharing.
